name: provenance_before_build
command:
# Fixed read-only gate for this one prepared binding; execute only after Root's slot grant.
# Reuses existing native common APIs. It never compiles, links, loads a GUI or opens SQL.
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
binding_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
binding_sha = sys.argv[2]
phase = sys.argv[3]
if phase not in ("before_build", "before_link", "after_link", "after_run"):
    raise RuntimeError("Unsupported fixed binding-check phase")
def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
if digest(binding_path) != binding_sha:
    raise RuntimeError("Root-reviewed binding metadata changed")
binding = json.loads(binding_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
common = Path(binding["common"]["path"])
if digest(common) != binding["common"]["sha256"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Existing approved native common changed")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("formal_flow_native02_readonly_checks", common)
api = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(api)
for key in ("native_receipt", "producer_makefile", "approved_freeze", "native_freeze",
            "native_after", "native_parent", "tools_before", "tools_after",
            "producer_control_before", "producer_control_after"):
    row = binding[key]
    api.require(api.sha(row["path"]) == row["sha256"], "Producer receipt/input changed: " + key)
frozen = api.load(binding["native_freeze"]["path"])
api.require(len(frozen) == 497 and frozen == api.load(binding["approved_freeze"]["path"])
            == api.load(binding["native_after"]["path"]), "497-source dictionaries differ")
# This existing API checks actual formal source/header/resources, Makefile,
# main/helper artifacts and all233 original native object SHA values.
native = api.verify_native(frozen)
api.require(native["actual_exit"] == 0 and native["source_inputs"] == 497
            and api.load(binding["native_parent"]["path"])["actual_exit"] == 0,
            "Original actual native main/helper/Windows receipts are not successful")
api.require(api.verify_controller_inputs() == api.load(binding["producer_control_before"]["path"])
            == api.load(binding["producer_control_after"]["path"]),
            "Native producer controller inputs changed")
api.require(api.load(binding["tools_before"]["path"]) == binding["tools"]
            == api.load(binding["tools_after"]["path"]), "Original9-tool receipts differ")
for path, expected in binding["tools"].items():
    api.require(api.sha(path) == expected, "Actual producer tool changed: " + path)
for row in binding["test_inputs"]:
    path = Path(row["path"])
    api.require(path.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and api.sha(path) == row["sha256"],
                "Sealed01 driver/inputs changed: " + str(path))
production = {key: row for key, row in native["fresh_objects"].items()
              if key.startswith("wsl_release/")}
planned = {row["native_receipt_key"]: row for row in binding["reused_objects"]}
excluded = binding["excluded_main"]["native_receipt_key"]
api.require(len(production) == 203 and excluded == "wsl_release/.obj/main.o"
            and len(planned) == 202 and set(planned) == set(production) - {excluded},
            "Wrong production object set or main exclusion")
for key, row in planned.items():
    api.require(row["expected_object_sha256"] == production[key]["sha256"],
                "Planned production object does not match original receipt: " + key)
helper = binding["expected_helper"]
api.require(api.sha(helper["path"]) == helper["sha256"]
            == native["artifacts"]["sn100_report_renderer"], "Wrong actual formal helper")
obj = Path(binding["expected_new_driver_object"])
binary = Path(binding["expected_new_driver_binary"])
build = binary.parent
if phase == "before_build":
    api.require(not build.exists(), "New driver build directory already exists; no reuse/retry")
else:
    api.require(obj.is_file() and list(build.rglob("*.o")) == [obj],
                "Exactly one new driver object required; no copied production/test objects")
    api.require(binary.exists() == (phase in ("after_link", "after_run")),
                "Unexpected old/missing linked driver")
print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "phase": phase, "source_headers_resources": 497,
                  "native_receipt_objects_checked_by_existing_api": 233,
                  "production_main_objects": 203, "production_objects_reused": 202,
                  "new_driver_object_expected": 1, "new_moc_expected": 0,
                  "new_driver_object_sha256": api.sha(obj) if obj.exists() else None,
                  "new_driver_binary_sha256": api.sha(binary) if binary.exists() else None},
                 ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
